_doc: Allowed entity names (STRATEGY 7.4 gate 5). A name that looks like an agency, company or airline and is not listed here blocks a post while config/legal.json legal_ok is not true (DECISIONS D-B), and is a warning on hand-written pages. 'allowed' = official bodies, airlines and the publisher; 'generic' = words that are not names (« agence Omra »).
